premise: Season 1, '100 Din Ka Rishta': Riya Saxena, 24, runs her late father's small bakery in Lucknow and is about to lose it to moneylender Gupta. Kabir Malhotra, 29, the cold heir of a Mumbai hotel empire, must be married within 100 days to keep control of the company from his scheming uncle Vikram. A chance meeting leads to a contract: a 100-day fake marriage in exchange for the bakery's debt. The rules are no feelings, no family drama and no one finds out. Over about 30 episodes every rule breaks. Riya moves into the Malhotra mansion in Mumbai and faces a suspicious family. Vikram's spy tries to expose the contract, Kabir's childhood friend becomes a second lead, and a family secret ties Riya's father's debt to the Malhotras. The two fall truly in love. The season ends with the contract exposed on day 100, and Kabir has to choose between the company and Riya.

episodes.title: Ep 1 | 100 दिन का रिश्ता: पाँच लाख का कर्ज़ और एक अजनबी का प्रस्ताव
episodes.summary: Moneylender Gupta gives Riya until tomorrow evening to repay 5 lakh or lose her late father's Lucknow bakery. A stranger, Kabir Malhotra, offers to clear the debt if she marries him for 100 days. She throws him out, but as the lock goes on the door she calls him and accepts. His first rule is 'don't fall in love', while someone in a black car secretly records them.

episodes.title: Ep 2 | 100 दिन का रिश्ता: कॉन्ट्रैक्ट, चाचा का फ़ोन और आज रात की शादी
episodes.summary: Kabir clears Riya's debt in front of a stunned Gupta, and they sign the 100-day contract, with Riya adding her own rule that he forgets her and the bakery afterward. Uncle Vikram calls Kabir with the secret video and threatens to show the family tomorrow, so Kabir tells Riya they must get married tonight.
